# Ultralytics YOLO26-n

Object Detection · `yolo26-n_640x640` · DX-APP C++ example

Object Detection model, evaluated on COCO.

**Input** 640 × 640 × 3 · **Dataset** COCO · **License** AGPL-3.0 · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro, Q-Master

![Ultralytics YOLO26-n output](../../../../python_example/object_detection/yolo26/yolo26-n_640x640/result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](../../../../python_example/object_detection/yolo26/yolo26-n_640x640/model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models yolo26n
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target yolo26-n_640x640_sync   # once
./bin/yolo26-n_640x640_sync \
  -m assets/models/yolo26-n_640x640.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/object_detection/yolo26/yolo26-n_640x640/yolo26-n_640x640_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/yolo26-n_640x640.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

## Performance

**321 FPS** and **438.3 FPS/W** on DX-M1, DX Model Zoo reference measurement (publish table, 2026-10-13).

### Accuracy

| Quantization | mAP |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 39.88 |
| Q-Lite | 39.08 (−0.80) |
| Q-Pro | 39.42 (−0.46) |
| Q-Master | 39.08 (−0.80) |

COCO · difference vs Raw in brackets.

### Measured on host boards

| Board | Throughput FPS | Single-stream FPS | Latency ms |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| DX-H1 Quattro · BIOSTAR | 1,326.0 | 96.4 | 10.4 |
| DX-M1 · AIPlayer N97 | 314.9 | 44.7 | 22.4 |
| DX-M1 · Orange Pi 5+ | 320.3 | 27.0 | 37.1 |
| DX-M1 · ROCK 5B+ | 319.3 | 29.2 | 34.3 |
| DX-M1 · Raspberry Pi 5 | 179.5 | 47.3 | 21.1 |
| DX-M1M · Raspberry Pi 5 | 179.2 | 44.4 | 22.5 |

DX AI Studio Benchmark, July 2026, DX-RT without ORT. Throughput: 5 in-flight buffers. Single-stream: 1.
